about.title: About the project
about.description: A time capsule for your memories — send something to yourself or to the people you care about, and let it arrive years from now.

steps.1: You write a message and attach images in the browser.
steps.2: Images go straight to object storage over a signed upload target — the API never touches the bytes.
steps.3: The capsule is stored in Postgres with the delivery date you chose.
steps.4: A scheduled dispatcher claims capsules that are due and sends them over SMTP.

spoiler.text: This site is a pet project developed by Maxim Barannikov (tg:{'@'}PureLeach). The goal was to go through every stage of building a web application single-handedly: design, code, frontend and backend integration, and deployment. Since it was built alone with limited time, bugs may show up. If you notice one, please report it through the feedback form — it helps me make the project better. Any feedback and suggestions are welcome. The full source code is publicly available on GitHub. Thank you for your attention and support!
